basics.name: Weikang He
basics.label: 何玮康
basics.summary: Ph.D. candidate at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications (CQUPT), advised by Prof. Yunpeng Xiao. Research interests include social computing, information diffusion, information retrieval, sequential recommendation, rumor propagation modeling, multi-source data fusion, user behavior modeling, deep learning, and graph mining.
